fields.Name: ORD-46 - Service Period Lock
fields.Description: A service period may be set on the order of a CLOSED deal (SP1-SP3). The deal lock refuses order-line edits while the deal is closed, and its refusal names what it protects: what was sold. Service dates are the coverage window rather than the thing, and they are the one field a rep must be able to set on a Won deal's order — ConfirmEligibility will not confirm a line whose product requires a service period until it carries both a start and an end, while Sales can state only a term start on a deal line, so the end can only be set here. The unit suite pins which saves consult the veto; this bundle proves the exempt save actually lands against a live database, and that the two bounds hold.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: With a veto registered that refuses every edit: a save touching only ServicePeriodStart and ServicePeriodEnd on an unbooked order goes through and the stored row really carries the new dates. The same save carrying a quantity change is refused, says the deal is closed, and leaves no part of itself behind — neither the quantity nor the dates. A dates-only save on a line whose order has booked is refused, because by then the stored period is the settled term that recognition is derived from; the line is reloaded rather than reused, so the check meets the lock rather than the bypass Orders' own write paths set.
